say:2:1111007001:1.text: Walker, you sly old fox! Never thought you'd be the one to rescue me.
say:2:1111007001:1.source_cn: 瓦尔克，你这老狐狸！没想到我会有被你救的一天。

say:3:1111007002:1.text: This Mauler kid is your new partner? Looks sharp.
say:3:1111007002:1.source_cn: 这蛮血少年是你的新搭档？不错啊，看起来身手不差。

choice_prompt:4:1111007002.text: This Mauler kid is your new partner? Looks sharp.
choice_prompt:4:1111007002.source_cn: 这蛮血少年是你的新搭档？不错啊，看起来身手不差。

say:5:1111007003:1.text: Yes. Bounty hunters often travel together. You know, if there is an accident, someone can help collect your body... Loners like Walker are extremely rare.
say:5:1111007003:1.source_cn: 当然，赏金猎人常常结伴而行，要是出了意外，能有人收敛遗...
say:5:1111007003:1.male: Yes. Bounty hunters often travel together. You know, if there is an accident, someone can help collect your body... Loners like Walker are extremely rare.
say:5:1111007003:1.female: Yes. Bounty hunters often travel together. You know, if there is an accident, someone can help collect your body... Loners like Walker are extremely rare.

say:7:1111007005:1.text: So, how did they manage to nab you? If word gets out, you'll have a tough time scoring another job.
say:7:1111007005:1.source_cn: 你是怎么被绑的？这事要是传出去，哪个雇主还会找你。

say:8:1111007006:1.text: Hmph! The head of that merchant caravan hired me to escort them out of the Eroded Enclave.
say:8:1111007006:1.source_cn: 哼，就旁边那个旅商，他们商队领头人雇的我。要我保护他们...

say:9:1111007007:1.text: And what brings you here now? Still chasing after Ferranc?
say:9:1111007007:1.source_cn: 你又为什么来这里？难道，你还要找弗兰克……

say:10:1111007008:1.text: Exactly. Need to settle things with him.

say:11:1111007009:1.text: Alone? You're planning to storm the Quicksand Claws' main camp solo? Word is, he's gotten even craftier and those Claws are multiplying.
say:11:1111007009:1.source_cn: 就你一个人？你准备单枪匹马闯进流沙之爪主营？我听说他比...

say:12:1111007010:1.text: I know you're a great shooter, but I hope the tragedy that happened with <style="highlight">Wyatt</style> won't repeat itself.
say:12:1111007010:1.source_cn: 我知道你对枪法很自信，但……别重蹈<style=hig...

choice_prompt:13:1111007010.text: I know you're a great shooter, but I hope the tragedy that happened with <style="highlight">Wyatt</style> won't repeat itself.
choice_prompt:13:1111007010.source_cn: 我知道你对枪法很自信，但……别重蹈<style=highlight>怀亚特</style>的覆辙。

say:14:1111007011:1.text: It's the name of a gun.
say:14:1111007011:1.male: It's the name of a gun.
say:14:1111007011:1.female: It's the name of a gun.

say:15:1111007012:1.text: Jacob, you're getting rusty. Can't believe you got captured by a Claw.
say:15:1111007012:1.source_cn: 杰布，你的枪没以前快了，竟然会被这几个流沙之爪俘获。

say:16:1111007013:1.text: Well, go drown your sorrows and enjoy this second lease on life.
say:16:1111007013:1.source_cn: 去找个酒吧把自己灌醉，好好庆祝劫后余生吧。

say:17:1111007014:1.text: Who knows? Perhaps it's time to retire.
say:17:1111007014:1.source_cn: 谁知道呢，也许我已经不适合再干这行了。

say:18:1111007015:1.text: See ya, Walker. I hope to see you again, just not at a funeral.
say:18:1111007015:1.source_cn: 再见，瓦尔克。希望我们再见时不是在葬礼上。
